upgrades.name: Ion Surge
upgrades.tooltip: Temporarily speeds up the fleet.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: Pulls gems toward the home base, nearer gems faster.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field Strength
upgrades.tooltip: The Tractor Field pulls harder.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field Falloff
upgrades.tooltip: Changes how quickly the pull weakens with distance.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field Range
upgrades.tooltip: The Tractor Field reaches farther.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: The Tractor Field activates more often.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field Duration
upgrades.tooltip: The Tractor Field lasts longer.

upgrades.name: Drifter Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: The Tractor Field also pulls gems toward each Drifter.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field: Drones
upgrades.tooltip: The Tractor Field also pulls gems toward drones.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field: Beacons
upgrades.tooltip: Places beacons around the home base that also pull gems in.

upgrades.name: Beacon Collection
upgrades.tooltip: Beacons collect the gems they pull in.

upgrades.name: Graviton Cascade
upgrades.tooltip: Gravity chains pull distant gems to the home base.

upgrades.name: Chain Reaction
upgrades.tooltip: Each chained gem hooks two nearby gems, branching twice.

upgrades.name: Superconductor
upgrades.tooltip: Aftershocks can trigger more aftershocks, up to four waves.

upgrades.name: Chain Aftershock
upgrades.tooltip: Chains can trigger a second chain.

upgrades.name: Aftershock Chance
upgrades.tooltip: Aftershocks trigger more often.

upgrades.name: Cascade Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: The Graviton Cascade fires more often.

upgrades.name: Chain Count
upgrades.tooltip: More chains.

upgrades.name: Drone Swarm
upgrades.tooltip: Launches drones that collect gems and fly them home.

upgrades.name: Swarm Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: The Drone Swarm launches more often.

upgrades.name: Swarm Size
upgrades.tooltip: More drones.

upgrades.name: Drone Lifetime
upgrades.tooltip: Drones stay out longer.

upgrades.name: Drone Engines
upgrades.tooltip: Drones fly faster.

upgrades.name: Collection Range
upgrades.tooltip: Drones collect from farther away.

upgrades.name: Final Sweep
upgrades.tooltip: When their time runs out, drones sweep up every gem within 300 units before heading home.

upgrades.name: Afterburners
upgrades.tooltip: Drones fly home at double speed.

upgrades.name: Drone Recharge
upgrades.tooltip: Each gem collected adds a little drone lifetime, up to double.

upgrades.name: Cargo Racks
upgrades.tooltip: Drones carry more. Full drones deliver and retire.

upgrades.name: Delivery Value
upgrades.tooltip: Drones deliver more value per gem.

upgrades.name: Genesis Pulse
upgrades.tooltip: The home base spawns rings of fresh gems around itself.

upgrades.name: Pulse Yield
upgrades.tooltip: More gems per pulse.

upgrades.name: Pulse Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: The Genesis Pulse fires more often.

upgrades.name: Extra Rings
upgrades.tooltip: Adds another ring, each with fewer gems than the last.

upgrades.name: Ring Loss
upgrades.tooltip: Outer rings lose fewer gems.

upgrades.name: Seeker Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: The Tractor Field also pulls gems toward each Seeker.

upgrades.name: Prospector Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: The Tractor Field also pulls gems toward each Prospector.

upgrades.name: Trove Hunter Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: The Tractor Field also pulls gems toward each Trove Hunter.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: The Tractor Field also pulls gems toward each Rimrunner.

upgrades.name: Residual Charge
upgrades.tooltip: Chained gems gain value. Aftershocks get half the bonus.

upgrades.name: Sweep Efficiency
upgrades.tooltip: Final Sweep gems are worth more.

upgrades.name: Rich Veins
upgrades.tooltip: Pulse gems have a chance to be worth double.

upgrades.name: Constellation
upgrades.tooltip: Chain targets form a net that collapses toward the home base, capturing the gems inside.

upgrades.name: Constellation Capacity
upgrades.tooltip: Constellation nets capture more gems.

upgrades.name: Crystal Bloom
upgrades.tooltip: Some pulse gems become seed crystals that burst into 4 gems when collected.

upgrades.name: Genesis Spiral
upgrades.tooltip: Rings spin out in faster pulses and finish with a double-value ring.

upgrades.name: Midas Pulse
upgrades.tooltip: A golden wave doubles the value of gems around the home base.

upgrades.name: Storm Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Drones zap nearby gems with chain lightning and collect them.

upgrades.name: Arc Reach
upgrades.tooltip: Lightning reaches farther.

upgrades.name: Storm Chains
upgrades.tooltip: Each lightning chain collects more gems.

upgrades.name: Rapid Discharge
upgrades.tooltip: Lightning fires more often.

upgrades.name: Relay Protocol
upgrades.tooltip: Drones fly one more sortie before retiring.

upgrades.name: Overcharge
upgrades.tooltip: Each gem collected makes a drone faster and widens its pickup, up to double.

upgrades.name: Avalanche
upgrades.tooltip: Chain Reaction hooks three gems per branch and branches three times.

upgrades.name: Event Horizon
upgrades.tooltip: Constellation nets grow 50% wider and capture twice as many gems.

upgrades.name: Reaction Reach
upgrades.tooltip: Chain Reaction jumps farther.

upgrades.name: Cascade Velocity
upgrades.tooltip: Chains pull faster.

upgrades.name: Constellation Reach
upgrades.tooltip: Constellation nets grow wider.

upgrades.name: Cosmic Genesis
upgrades.tooltip: Genesis Spiral's finale has twice the gems, each worth four times as much.

upgrades.name: Worldseed
upgrades.tooltip: Every ring gets seed crystals, and seeds hold twice the value.

upgrades.name: Golden Age
upgrades.tooltip: Midas Pulse makes gems worth four times as much and reaches twice as many.

upgrades.name: Bloom Seeds
upgrades.tooltip: One more seed crystal per pulse.

upgrades.name: Golden Reach
upgrades.tooltip: Midas Pulse reaches farther.

upgrades.name: Golden Capacity
upgrades.tooltip: Midas Pulse gilds more gems.

upgrades.name: Core Drill
upgrades.tooltip: Launches a drill pod that bores out deep gems. While it drills, weapons deal 25% more damage.

upgrades.name: Drill Speed
upgrades.tooltip: The drill bores faster.

upgrades.name: Bit Depth
upgrades.tooltip: The drill reaches one layer deeper.

upgrades.name: Drill Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: The Core Drill launches more often.

upgrades.name: Fault Lines
upgrades.tooltip: Cracks spread from the bore hole and leak gems.

upgrades.name: Pressure Build
upgrades.tooltip: The drill digs one layer deeper every second.

upgrades.name: Seismic Resonance
upgrades.tooltip: While drilling, the damage bonus rises to 50% and weapons reach a layer deeper.

upgrades.name: Fault Count
upgrades.tooltip: One more crack.

upgrades.name: Bore Time
upgrades.tooltip: The drill bores for longer.

upgrades.name: Resonance Depth
upgrades.tooltip: Weapons reach one more layer deeper during the resonance.

upgrades.name: Fault Leak
upgrades.tooltip: Cracks leak more gems.

upgrades.name: Rich Ore
upgrades.tooltip: Drilled gems are worth more.

upgrades.name: Lingering Tremors
upgrades.tooltip: The drill's bonuses last longer after it finishes.

upgrades.name: Tectonic Rupture
upgrades.tooltip: When the drill finishes, every crack bursts in a ring of deep gems.

upgrades.name: Core Tap
upgrades.tooltip: The drill finishes with a geyser of core gems worth three times as much.

upgrades.name: Hollow World
upgrades.tooltip: Each finished drill leaves tunnels: planet hits deal 3% more damage for the rest of the run, up to 45%.

upgrades.name: Kamikaze Wing
upgrades.tooltip: Bomber drones dive into the planet and detonate for twelve times your strongest weapon's power.

upgrades.name: Wing Size
upgrades.tooltip: One more bomber per wing.

upgrades.name: Shaped Warheads
upgrades.tooltip: Bigger blasts.

upgrades.name: Rapid Rearm
upgrades.tooltip: The wing launches more often.

upgrades.name: Cluster Bombs
upgrades.tooltip: Blasts scatter bomblets that burst for 30% of the blast.

upgrades.name: Volatile Payload
upgrades.tooltip: Bombers have a 20% chance to go critical for triple damage.

upgrades.name: Second Sortie
upgrades.tooltip: Each blast has a 25% chance to launch another bomber.

upgrades.name: Bomblet Count
upgrades.tooltip: One more bomblet per blast.

upgrades.name: Unstable Core
upgrades.tooltip: Bombers go critical more often.

upgrades.name: Quick Turnaround
upgrades.tooltip: Second sorties launch more often.

upgrades.name: Bunker Busters
upgrades.tooltip: Bombers reach one layer deeper.

upgrades.name: Critical Mass
upgrades.tooltip: Critical bombers hit even harder.

upgrades.name: Afterburner Dive
upgrades.tooltip: Bombers dive faster.

upgrades.name: Firestorm
upgrades.tooltip: Blasts leave molten craters that keep dealing damage. Magma Detonation sets them off.

upgrades.name: Doomsday Drone
upgrades.tooltip: The last bomber of each wing hits eight times as hard and sends a quake all around the planet.

upgrades.name: Hive Mind
upgrades.tooltip: Each blast takes a second off your other ship systems' cooldowns.
